```{r}
#| label: knn-config

#CHANGE THESE LINES TO SWITCH WEIGHTING
weighting    <- "rectangular"                       
weight_label <- "standard (rectangular)"            

k_values <- c(5, 15, 25, 31, 51, 71, 101)
```

###  Standard KNN with Tuned Neighborhood Size

We fit a standard K-nearest neighbors classifier using the kknn engine with `weight_func = "rectangular". We then tune the number of neighbors. Each candidate is evaluated using 5-fold stratified cross-validation on the training set only, with classification accuracy and multi-class ROC-AUC as metrics.

```{r}
#| label: knn-tune

knn_spec <- nearest_neighbor(neighbors = tune(), weight_func = weighting) |>
  set_engine("kknn") |>
  set_mode("classification")

knn_wf <- workflow() |>
  add_recipe(knn_rec) |>
  add_model(knn_spec)

knn_grid <- tibble(neighbors = k_values)

set.seed(197)
knn_tuned <- tune_grid(
  knn_wf,
  resamples = spotify_folds,
  grid = knn_grid,
  metrics = metric_set(accuracy, roc_auc)
)
```

```{r}
#| label: knn-table

knn_results <- collect_metrics(knn_tuned) |>
  select(neighbors, .metric, mean, std_err) |>
  pivot_wider(names_from = .metric, values_from = c(mean, std_err)) |>
  arrange(neighbors) |>
  select(
    k = neighbors,
    mean_accuracy = mean_accuracy,
    se_accuracy = std_err_accuracy,
    mean_roc_auc = mean_roc_auc,
    se_roc_auc = std_err_roc_auc
  )

knn_results |>
  knitr::kable(
    digits = 4,
    caption = paste0("5-fold CV performance for ", weight_label, " KNN by k")
  )
```

```{r}
#| label: knn-plot
#| fig-cap: !expr paste0("Cross-validated accuracy and ROC-AUC across values of k (", weight_label, " weighting)")

collect_metrics(knn_tuned) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = neighbors, y = mean)) +
  geom_line() +
  geom_point() +
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = mean - std_err, ymax = mean + std_err), width = 2) +
  facet_wrap(~ .metric, scales = "free_y") +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = k_values) +
  labs(x = "Number of neighbors (k)", y = "Mean 5-fold CV estimate") +
  theme_minimal()
```

```{r}
#| label: knn-select

best_k <- select_best(knn_tuned, metric = "roc_auc")
best_row <- knn_results |> filter(k == best_k$neighbors)
```

Using mean ROC-AUC as the selection criterion, cross-validation favors k = 51 for the model, which achieves a mean ROC-AUC of 0.792 (and a mean accuracy of 0.461.

### Final Model Evaluation on the Test Set

We finalize the workflow with the selected k, refit it on the full training set, and evaluate it once on the test set to obtain an unbiased estimate of performance.

```{r}
#| label: knn-final

final_knn_wf <- finalize_workflow(knn_wf, best_k)

final_knn_fit <- last_fit(
  final_knn_wf,
  spotify_split,
  metrics = metric_set(accuracy, roc_auc)
)

collect_metrics(final_knn_fit) |>
  select(.metric, .estimate) |>
  knitr::kable(
    digits = 4,
    caption = paste0("Test-set performance for ", weight_label, " KNN (k = ", best_k$neighbors, ")")
  )
```
